title: Make room for the Name by wanting less
summary: The Name needs an uncluttered heart, not one crammed with gain. Choose the profit that can still travel.
takeaway: Choose the profit that can still travel.
lifeApplication: When appetite starts calling itself need, stop with your hand on the card or screen and choose the quieter wealth.

source.shortMeaning: The Name needs an uncluttered heart, not one crammed with gain.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next grasping move, ask what can actually travel with the soul.

evidence.coreClaim: The Name needs an uncluttered heart, not one crammed with gain.
evidence.turn: Keep only the speech that can stand at God's Door.
evidence.practicalImplication: When appetite starts calling itself need, stop with your hand on the card or screen and choose the quieter wealth.
